public_sentence: This file is the same file witnesses saw.
notes: Avoid implying the content is true merely because it is unchanged.

public_sentence: The expected notice was not found by the stated deadline.
when_to_use: When a publication contract requires an artifact that is absent.
notes: Do not translate missingness into intent or fraud.

public_sentence: Different audiences saw different official information.
when_to_use: When monitor perspectives disagree on a public surface.
notes: Pair with exact time window and surface ID.

public_sentence: These independent parties checked the same artifact.
when_to_use: When explaining quorum or witness evidence.

public_sentence: The signing key changed; here is the signed explanation.
when_to_use: When a public artifact signer changes.

public_sentence: This packet passed or failed these checks.
notes: Publish failures as bounded problem codes.
